provenance.command_signed: kevgate-admit serve --self-signed --policy-file signed-policy.yaml --kev-file deploy/demo/kev-demo.json --evidence-dir SIGNED_REPORTS --evidence-public-key-file report-key.pub.pem
provenance.label: Synthetic demo data and test output from a locally run webhook, not a cluster run.

images.label: clean
images.what: Digest-pinned; the report lists three low and medium findings, none in KEV.

images.label: kev-vulnerable
images.what: Digest-pinned; the report lists CVE-2021-44228, which the demo KEV subset contains.

images.label: over-threshold
images.what: Digest-pinned; no KEV finding, but CVE-2099-10004 scores above 40 (CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.9).

images.label: tag-only
images.what: A tag, no digest. The webhook never resolves tags.

images.label: malformed reference
images.what: A path with a dot segment. Earlier builds accepted it; the strict OCI-grammar parser rejects it.

policies.label: demo-enforce
policies.summary: mode enforce; denyKev, maxRisk 40, requireDigest, requireEvidence deny, registry registry.example.com/demo only

policies.label: demo-audit
policies.summary: same rules, mode audit: the request is admitted and the would-be denials come back as warnings

policies.label: any other namespace
policies.summary: the policy's default rule: denyKev, requireDigest, requireEvidence deny; no maxRisk, no registry list
